scope: At most twelve evenly spaced unique successful receipts per venue, finalized reread without retries. This biased bounded subset does not estimate true creation frequency or repair gaps. Existing strict verifier remains the only creation authority; ordinary swaps and historical reinspection cannot become fresh events.
